blurb: Guests sail on a 60-foot steel-hull expedition sailing ship that can break through pack ice and approach glaciers. Trips include hiking, fishing, kayaking, and wildlife viewing such as whales, bears, and eagles. The ship sleeps up to 6 passengers plus the captain, with group participation in cooking encouraged but not required.
